> A PCB design to to use it for a robotic arm project (basically Breach is a character in valorant having a mechanical arm.) So this PCB will have a power supply for motors and slots for connecting the motor. Then It will have pins to connect the XIAO RP2040 microcontroller (basically the microcontroller for this project).

## Design

### 2026-10-06 — I was deciding the electronics to use for this project. Like which servo motor should I use, which MCU would be good for this project. I had to figure this out first as diff servo motors have diff ope

**0.3h**

I was deciding the electronics to use for this project. Like which servo motor should I use, which MCU would be good for this project. I had to figure this out first as diff servo motors have diff operating voltages. So I will have to design the PCB considering this in mind. From the 12V common input I will step down voltages acc to the motors I am using.

### 2026-10-06 — I was working on figuring out the voltages and torque of different motors because I will have to design the power rail according to this. I figured I will have two slots for stepper motors powered at

**0.7h**

I was working on figuring out the voltages and torque of different motors because I will have to design the power rail according to this. I figured I will have two slots for stepper motors powered at 12 V supply. Then to power the servos I will use two rails - 5V and 6V . All these voltages will be acheived by stepping down the 12V main supply to the required voltage.
